identitySignals: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists a 501(c)(3) named 'American Indian Model Schools' in Oakland, CA (EIN 94-3309981), the operator of American Indian Public High School per Wikipedia
AIMS K-12's Milestones page says the organization changed its name from 'American Indian Model Schools' in 2019 and lists American Indian Public High School (founded 2006) as its high school
The school is in Oakland, CA (746 Grand Ave), and OUSD's agenda items are facilities use agreements with its Office of Charter Schools, consistent with an Oakland charter school
research.notes: The agenda names the school 'American Indian Public High School'; the organization renamed itself in 2019 (per aimsk12.org Milestones). The legal name is taken from the IRS/ProPublica record; the website calls the entity 'AIMS K-12 College Prep Charter District'. The old domain aimschools.org is now a parked page. CA Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked.

profile.summary: A nonprofit charter school organization in Oakland, California, now called AIMS K-12 College Prep Charter District. It runs public charter schools serving students from kindergarten through 12th grade, including a high school for grades 9 to 12. It began in 1996 as American Indian Public Charter School.

sources.title: American Indian Model Schools - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: AIMS K-12's Milestones and About pages confirm American Indian Public High School (2006, 746 Grand Ave, Oakland) is part of the district formerly American Indian Public Charter School, renamed in 2019; ProPublica confirms the 501(c)(3) American Indian Model Schools, EIN 94-3309981, in Oakland, and the contact page confirms the address, phone, email and website. The summary is neutral and supported.
